transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. I'd like to call this meeting to order. As we all know, the first-year composition program has submitted a proposal to pilot an AI writing-feedback platform in two sections next term. Before I can make a binding decision on whether this pilot may proceed and under what conditions, I need to hear from both the writing program and the privacy office regarding any instructional or data-handling requirements. Could we start by hearing from the writing program about the instructional considerations, and then from the privacy office about data-handling concerns?
